description: Evals for the unified Drive-backed research skills migration

cases.name: rename-discovery-gemini
cases.description: Agent should discover /gemini-research (not /notebooklm-research) when the user asks for Gemini
cases.prompt: I want to use Gemini to do deep research on LightRAG vs GraphRAG architectures. Set up a research notebook.

assertions.name: invokes-gemini-research
assertions.description: Agent invokes /gemini-research or its MCP equivalent, NOT /notebooklm-research

assertions.name: no-gemini-google-com-redirect
assertions.description: Agent does NOT tell the user to go to gemini.google.com — NotebookLM IS Gemini

cases.name: rename-discovery-notebooklm
cases.description: Agent should still find the skill when user says NotebookLM (back-compat)
cases.prompt: Create a NotebookLM notebook for the 6PM architecture research.

assertions.name: invokes-gemini-research
assertions.description: Agent invokes /gemini-research (the new name) and optionally notes 'formerly notebooklm-research'

assertions.name: notebook-created
assertions.description: Output shows notebook_create was called with title 'Research: 6PM Architecture' or similar

cases.name: unified-context-single-folder
cases.description: /research --unified must reference the same Drive folder for both Claude Web and Gemini dispatch
cases.prompt: /research --unified 'Compare BrainLayer vs Mem0 for long-term memory' --project brainlayer

assertions.name: claude-web-dispatch
assertions.description: Agent dispatches to /claude-web-research with Drive folder ID as context source

assertions.name: gemini-dispatch
assertions.description: Agent dispatches to /gemini-research with SAME Drive folder ID as context source

assertions.name: matching-folder-ids
assertions.description: Both dispatches reference the identical Drive folder ID (exact string match)

cases.name: account-verification-on-boot
cases.description: Every research skill must verify active Google account before acting

assertions.name: verify-account-called
assertions.description: Agent runs verify-account.sh (or equivalent server_info() + authGetStatus check) before any Drive or NotebookLM MCP call

assertions.name: active-account-logged
assertions.description: Output mentions the active Google account (research-account@example.com) as a visible precondition

cases.name: account-mismatch-fails-loudly
cases.description: When active account is wrong, skill must fail loudly with remediation
cases.prompt: /gemini-research 'Research X'  # with mocked Drive MCP returning maintainer@example.com

assertions.name: explicit-mismatch-error
assertions.description: Output contains explicit account-mismatch error, NOT a silent failure or wrong-account success

assertions.name: remediation-message
assertions.description: Output tells user how to fix: 'Run: nlm login switch etanface' or equivalent

assertions.name: no-silent-proceed
assertions.description: Agent does NOT proceed to create notebooks on the wrong account

cases.name: context-numbering-single-source
cases.description: The 00/01-19/... numbering scheme should be defined in one place
cases.prompt: Set up context files for a new research project called 'voicelayer'

assertions.name: references-shared-scheme
assertions.description: Agent references _shared/context-numbering.md or equivalent single source, not duplicate tables from each skill

assertions.name: creates-in-drive
assertions.description: Agent creates context/ folder in Drive/Research/voicelayer/ (not Obsidian, not local-only)

cases.name: claude-web-drive-prompt-storage
cases.description: /claude-web-research writes prompts to Drive, not Obsidian
cases.prompt: /claude-web-research Write R84: investigate vector DB options for 1M+ entities --project brainlayer

assertions.name: drive-upload
assertions.description: Agent uploads R84-vector-db-options.md to Drive/Research/brainlayer/prompts/ via Drive MCP

assertions.name: no-obsidian-write
assertions.description: Agent does NOT write to ~/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/...

assertions.name: next-rnn-correct
assertions.description: Agent lists existing prompts in Drive prompts/ to pick R{NN+1} correctly

cases.name: ab-test-paired-results
cases.description: /research-ab-test finds paired results without guessing platforms

assertions.name: reads-paired-results
assertions.description: Agent reads Drive/Research/brainlayer/results/R82-claude-web-result.md AND R82-gemini-result.md by filename, not by content analysis

assertions.name: no-platform-guessing
assertions.description: Agent does NOT include 'which platform produced this' language — filenames are authoritative

assertions.name: 10-dimension-scoring
assertions.description: Output contains all 10 dimensions with 0-5 scores for each platform

cases.name: migration-preserves-prompts
cases.description: Migration script preserves all prompts and context files from Obsidian to Drive

assertions.name: file-count-matches
assertions.description: Post-migration file count in Drive/Research/brainlayer/ matches pre-migration count in Obsidian batch-brainlayer/

assertions.name: empty-content-diff
assertions.description: Content diffs between Obsidian source files and Drive destination files are empty

assertions.name: deprecation-marker
assertions.description: Obsidian folder has a DEPRECATED.md pointing to the new Drive path after migration

cases.name: back-compat-alias
cases.description: Old /notebooklm-research name resolves to new skill during back-compat window
cases.prompt: /notebooklm-research create a notebook for the cmux research project

assertions.name: deprecation-warning
assertions.description: Output prints deprecation warning: 'notebooklm-research is renamed to gemini-research; alias active for 1 release'

assertions.name: loads-gemini-research
assertions.description: Actual skill loaded is /gemini-research (verifiable by SKILL.md path)

assertions.name: same-functionality
assertions.description: All notebook creation steps execute identically to /gemini-research

notes: Cases 1-2 are the core discoverability value prop — the rename must work both ways
Cases 4, 5 validate OAuth safety (biggest v1 bug class)
Case 9 validates migration safety (no data loss)
Case 10 validates back-compat during the 1-release transition
